<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>@ayanbukhari279 – Ronaldo Edits & Song Promo</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Big+Shoulders+Display:wght@800;900&family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;600&display=swap">
<style>
:root{--red:#b3122b;--ink:#1b0a0e;--paper:#fbf7f6;--gold:#ffffff;--line:#e6d9db;--muted:#6b5459;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:400 17px/1.6 "Instrument Sans",system-ui,sans-serif}
h1,h2{font-family:"Big Shoulders Display","Arial Narrow",Impact,sans-serif;font-weight:900;line-height:.9;margin:0;letter-spacing:.005em}
a{color:inherit}
.wrap{max-width:960px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 22px}
.hero{position:relative;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 10%,rgba(255,255,255,.28),transparent 45%),linear-gradient(160deg,#b3122b 0%,#7d0c1e 58%,#0b3d2a 135%);color:#fff;padding:56px 0 0;overflow:hidden}
.hero::before{content:"7";position:absolute;right:-2%;top:-6%;font:900 clamp(320px,62vw,720px)/1 "Big Shoulders Display",Impact,sans-serif;color:#fff;opacity:.13;pointer-events:none}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1}
.profile{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;margin-bottom:26px}
.avatar{width:128px;height:128px;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid var(--gold);background:#3a1a21;overflow:hidden;display:grid;place-items:center;font:900 64px "Big Shoulders Display",sans-serif;color:var(--gold)}
.avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.pname{font-size:22px;font-weight:600}
.handle{font-weight:600;margin:0 0 18px;opacity:.9}
h1{font-size:clamp(76px,19vw,200px);text-transform:uppercase}
.sub{font-size:clamp(18px,2.6vw,24px);max-width:30ch;margin:22px 0 30px}
.btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;padding-bottom:44px}
.btn{display:inline-block;border:2px solid #fff;color:#fff;background:transparent;padding:14px 24px;font:600 17px "Instrument Sans",sans-serif;text-decoration:none;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer}
.btn.fill{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--ink)}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px #1b0a0e}
/* editing timeline */
.timeline{background:var(--ink);padding:14px 0 18px;position:relative}
.track{display:flex;gap:4px;height:34px;margin-bottom:6px}
.clip{border-radius:5px;background:#3a1a21}
.clip.a{background:var(--red)}.clip.b{background:var(--gold)}
.playhead{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:0;width:2px;background:#fff;animation:play 5s cubic-bezier(.5,0,.2,1) 1 forwards}
.playhead::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:-6px;border:7px solid transparent;border-top:9px solid #fff}
@keyframes play{to{left:100%}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.playhead{animation:none;left:34%}}
section{padding:68px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
h2{font-size:clamp(44px,8vw,76px);margin-bottom:22px;text-transform:uppercase}
p{max-width:62ch;margin:0 0 14px}
.steps{padding:0;margin:26px 0 0;list-style:none;display:grid;gap:18px}
.steps li{border-left:4px solid var(--red);padding-left:16px}
.steps b{display:block;font-size:19px}
@media(min-width:760px){.steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
form{display:grid;gap:16px;max-width:560px;margin-top:24px}
label{font-weight:600;display:grid;gap:6px;font-size:15px}
input,textarea{font:inherit;padding:13px 14px;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);width:100%}
textarea{min-height:100px;resize:vertical}
form .btn{background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red);justify-self:start}
.out{display:none;margin-top:22px;padding:18px;border:2px dashed var(--red);border-radius:12px;max-width:560px}
.out.show{display:block}
.out pre{white-space:pre-wrap;font:inherit;margin:10px 0 14px;background:#fff;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.out .btn{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}
footer{padding:34px 0 46px;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.hero{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:min(94vh,780px);background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(10,4,6,.82) 0%,rgba(10,4,6,.3) 55%,rgba(10,4,6,.05) 100%),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(179,18,43,.8) 0%,rgba(179,18,43,0) 38%),url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) 62% 0/cover no-repeat}
.hero .wrap{flex:1;width:100%}
.hero h1,.hero .sub,.pname{text-shadow:0 2px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
@media(max-width:700px){.hero{background-position:58% 0;background-image:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(10,4,6,.85) 0%,rgba(10,4,6,.45) 60%,rgba(10,4,6,.2) 100%),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(179,18,43,.7) 0%,rgba(179,18,43,0) 35%),url(data:image/jpeg;base64,)}}
.hero::before{display:none}

html,body{overflow-x:clip}
body{color:#f3eaea;background:radial-gradient(circle at 12% 6%,rgba(179,18,43,.34),transparent 38%),radial-gradient(circle at 92% 48%,rgba(179,18,43,.22),transparent 42%),radial-gradient(circle at 10% 92%,rgba(11,61,42,.35),transparent 40%),#0a0507}
p{color:rgba(243,234,234,.86)}
.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.16;mix-blend-mode:overlay;background:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='160' height='160'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.9' numOctaves='2'/></filter><rect width='160' height='160' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>")}
h1{text-shadow:0 4px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
h1 .stroke{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2px #fff;text-shadow:none}
.avatar{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(255,255,255,.14),0 0 46px rgba(179,18,43,.85)}
.btn{transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s,background .2s}
.btn.fill{box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.btn:not(.fill):hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.marquee{position:relative;z-index:2;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7d0c1e,#d01a38,#7d0c1e);border-block:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);transform:rotate(-1.4deg) scale(1.04);margin:-10px 0 26px;padding:10px 0;box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(179,18,43,.45)}
.mq{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:mq 30s linear infinite}
.mq>div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;padding-right:26px;white-space:nowrap}
.mq span{font:900 30px/1 "Big Shoulders Display","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.mq i{font-style:normal;opacity:.7}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.mq{animation:none}}
section{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
h2{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 35%,#f0657b);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
h2::after{content:"";display:block;width:70px;height:5px;margin-top:16px;background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(179,18,43,.9);border-radius:3px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;padding:0;margin:22px 0 24px;list-style:none}
.chips li{padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
.steps{counter-reset:s}
.steps li{counter-increment:s;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-top:3px solid var(--red);border-radius:16px;padding:22px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07),rgba(255,255,255,.02));transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s}
.steps li:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:rgba(240,101,123,.6)}
.steps li::before{content:counter(s);display:grid;place-items:center;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(179,18,43,.7);font:900 22px "Big Shoulders Display",sans-serif;margin-bottom:12px}
form{padding:26px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07),rgba(255,255,255,.02));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:20px;max-width:600px}
input,textarea{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18);color:#fff}
input::placeholder,textarea::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
input:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:#f0657b}
form .btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d01a38,#8f0f24);border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(179,18,43,.55)}
.out{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-color:#f0657b}
.out pre{background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.out .btn{color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.first{display:grid;gap:28px;align-items:center;margin-top:8px}
@media(min-width:760px){.first{grid-template-columns:300px 1fr}}
.vid{width:100%;max-width:300px;aspect-ratio:9/16;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,rgba(240,101,123,.4),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(160deg,#7d0c1e,#1b0a0e);display:grid;place-content:center;justify-items:center;gap:8px;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(179,18,43,.4);transition:transform .25s}
.vid:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
.vid .play{width:78px;height:78px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);border:2px solid #fff;display:grid;place-items:center}
.vid .play::after{content:"";margin-left:6px;border-left:24px solid #fff;border-block:15px solid transparent}
.vid b{font:900 28px "Big Shoulders Display",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}
.vid small{opacity:.8}
.flow{padding-left:22px;margin:0;display:grid;gap:18px}
.flow .btn{margin-top:8px}
.out .btn.fill{color:#1b0a0e;border-color:#fff}
.btn[aria-disabled]{opacity:.55;pointer-events:none}
footer{color:rgba(243,234,234,.6)}
@media(min-width:760px){.first{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.5fr) minmax(0,1fr)}}
.player{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:#000;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(179,18,43,.4)}
.part{margin-top:56px;padding-top:40px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.partH{font:900 clamp(32px,5.5vw,46px)/1 "Big Shoulders Display","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 18px}
.btns{padding-bottom:20px}
.herolinks{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;padding-bottom:44px}
.herolinks a{padding:9px 18px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(10,4,6,.55);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;text-decoration:none;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}
.herolinks a:hover{background:rgba(179,18,43,.85);border-color:#fff}
.herolinks a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px #1b0a0e}
.mailbtns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:8px}
.mailbtns .btn{margin-top:0}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="hero">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="profile"><div class="avatar" id="avatar"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Profile picture of @ayanbukhari279"></div><strong class="pname">@ayanbukhari279</strong></div>
    <h1>Ronaldo<br><span class="stroke">Edits</span></h1>
    <p class="sub">CapCut edits built around the moments fans replay. Want your song in one?</p>
    <div class="btns">
      <a class="btn fill" href="https://www.tiktok.com/@ayanbukhari279" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Watch on TikTok</a>
      <a class="btn" href="#request">Request an edit</a>
    </div>
    <nav class="herolinks" aria-label="Sections"><a href="#about">About me</a><a href="#how">Song promo</a><a href="#support">Support</a></nav>
  </div>
  <div class="timeline" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="wrap"><div class="track">
      <div class="clip a" style="flex:5"></div><div class="clip" style="flex:2"></div><div class="clip b" style="flex:3"></div><div class="clip a" style="flex:4"></div><div class="clip" style="flex:3"></div><div class="clip b" style="flex:2"></div><div class="clip a" style="flex:5"></div>
    </div></div>
    <div class="playhead"></div>
  </div>
</header>
<div class="marquee" aria-hidden="true"><div class="mq"><div><span>Ronaldo edits</span><i>&#10022;</i><span>CapCut</span><i>&#10022;</i><span>Song promo</span><i>&#10022;</i><span>Ronaldo edits</span><i>&#10022;</i><span>CapCut</span><i>&#10022;</i><span>Song promo</span><i>&#10022;</i></div><div><span>Ronaldo edits</span><i>&#10022;</i><span>CapCut</span><i>&#10022;</i><span>Song promo</span><i>&#10022;</i><span>Ronaldo edits</span><i>&#10022;</i><span>CapCut</span><i>&#10022;</i><span>Song promo</span><i>&#10022;</i></div></div></div>

<main>
<section id="about">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2>About me</h2>
    <p>Hey, I'm Ayan. I'm a CapCut editor and I love making edits, especially Ronaldo edits. Every clip gets cut to the beat, with smooth transitions, color work and effects that match the song.</p>
    <p>You can see my style on my TikTok. If you like it, I can make one for your track.</p>
    <ul class="chips"><li>Beat-synced cuts</li><li>Smooth transitions</li><li>Color grading</li><li>Effects that fit the song</li></ul>
    <a class="btn" style="margin-top:8px" href="https://www.tiktok.com/@ayanbukhari279" target="_blank" rel="noopener">See my edits on TikTok</a>
  <div id="first" class="part"><h3 class="partH">My first video</h3>
    <div class="first">
      <video class="player" controls playsinline preload="metadata" poster="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><source src="data:video/mp4;base64," type="video/mp4">Your browser does not support video.</video>
      <div>
        <p>This is my first video. I started editing 3 years ago, and I've kept learning with every edit since.</p>
        <p>It's pinned on my profile, so you can see where I started and how my style has grown.</p>
        <a class="btn" href="https://www.tiktok.com/@ayanbukhari279" target="_blank" rel="noopener">More on TikTok</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div></div>
</section>

<section id="how">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2>Song promo edits</h2>
    <p>Artists and producers: I turn your song into a Ronaldo edit and post it on my account.</p>
    <ol class="steps">
      <li><b>You send the song</b>Fill in the form below, send it by email, then pay in the last step.</li>
      <li><b>I cut the edit</b>I edit it in CapCut to fit the sound of your track.</li>
      <li><b>It goes live</b>I post it on TikTok and you get the link.</li>
    </ol>
  <div id="request" class="part"><h3 class="partH">Request an edit</h3>
    <p>Fill this in. Your email opens in Gmail, Outlook or your mail app with everything filled in. Then finish with the payment step.</p>
    <form id="f">
      <label>Your name or artist name<input id="name" required autocomplete="name"></label>
      <label>Your TikTok username<input id="tt" required placeholder="@yourname" autocomplete="off"></label>
      <label>Song title<input id="song" required></label>
      <label>Link to the song<input id="link" type="url" placeholder="https://" required></label>
      <label>Deadline (optional)<input id="when" placeholder="e.g. next Friday"></label>
      <label>Anything else? (optional)<textarea id="note"></textarea></label>
      <button class="btn" type="submit">Create my email request</button>
    </form>
    <div class="out" id="out" role="status">
      <strong id="status"></strong>
      <pre id="msg"></pre>
      <ol class="flow"><li>Send this email to me. Choose your email app:<br><span class="mailbtns"><a class="btn" id="gmail" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="#">Open in Gmail</a><a class="btn" id="outlook" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="#">Open in Outlook</a><a class="btn" id="mailapp" href="#">Open mail app</a></span></li><li>Last step: pay for your edit.<br><a class="btn fill" id="pay" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="#">Pay for your edit</a></li></ol>
    </div>
  </div></div>
</section>

<section id="support">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2>Support my edits</h2>
    <p>If you like my edits, you can support me with a small tip. It helps me keep editing and posting.</p>
    <a class="btn fill" id="donate" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="#">Support me</a>
  </div>
</section>
</main>

<footer><div class="wrap">Edits by @ayanbukhari279 · <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/@ayanbukhari279" target="_blank" rel="noopener">tiktok.com/@ayanbukhari279</a></div></footer>

<script>
var PAY_URL="";
(function(){var a=document.getElementById('pay');if(PAY_URL){a.href=PAY_URL}else{a.removeAttribute('href');a.setAttribute('aria-disabled','true');a.textContent='Payment link coming soon'}})();
var DONATE_URL="";
(function(){var a=document.getElementById('donate');if(DONATE_URL){a.href=DONATE_URL}else{a.removeAttribute('href');a.setAttribute('aria-disabled','true');a.textContent='Tip link coming soon'}})();
var OWNER_EMAIL="bukhariayan75@gmail.com";
document.getElementById('f').addEventListener('submit',function(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  var v=function(id){return document.getElementById(id).value.trim()};
  var tt=v('tt').replace(/^@/,'');
  var subject="Edit request: "+v('song');
  var t="Hi! I'm "+v('name')+" (TikTok: @"+tt+").\nI'd like a Ronaldo edit for my song \""+v('song')+"\".\nSong link: "+v('link');
  if(v('when'))t+="\nDeadline: "+v('when');
  if(v('note'))t+="\nNote: "+v('note');
  t+="\n\nYou can message me on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@"+tt;
  var ok=!!OWNER_EMAIL;
  var to=encodeURIComponent(OWNER_EMAIL),su=encodeURIComponent(subject),bo=encodeURIComponent(t);
  var g=document.getElementById('gmail'),o=document.getElementById('outlook'),m=document.getElementById('mailapp');
  if(ok){
    g.href="https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&to="+to+"&su="+su+"&body="+bo;
    o.href="https://outlook.live.com/mail/0/deeplink/compose?to="+to+"&subject="+su+"&body="+bo;
    m.href="mailto:"+OWNER_EMAIL+"?subject="+su+"&body="+bo;
  }
  [g,o,m].forEach(function(a){if(ok)a.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');else{a.removeAttribute('href');a.setAttribute('aria-disabled','true')}});
  document.getElementById('msg').textContent="To: "+(ok?OWNER_EMAIL:"(email address not set yet)")+"\nSubject: "+subject+"\n\n"+t;
  document.getElementById('status').textContent=ok?'Your email is ready. Choose where to open it:':'Email address not set yet. Copy this message and send it to me on TikTok.';
  var out=document.getElementById('out');
  out.classList.add('show');
  try{navigator.clipboard.writeText(t)}catch(err){}
  out.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'});
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
